chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Do not feel secure from the punishment of Allah regarding the best of this community,
because of His, the Exalted, saying: 'So no one feels secure against the plan of Allah except the people who are the losers.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to not feel safe from Allah's punishment even for the best of the community?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) warns against complacency regarding the righteous of the community, citing the verse 'Only the losers feel secure from Allah's plan' to illustrate that divine justice encompasses even the pious if they neglect vigilance. This narration, found in Nahj al-Balagha, underscores the Shia concept of *adl* (divine justice) where status does not grant immunity from accountability, emphasizing that true security lies in continuous awareness of God's decree rather than social standing.
